coverage.grouping: Lexically scan all source bytes, excluding interpreted strings, rune literals and raw strings. Combine adjacent line comments separated by exactly one newline and horizontal whitespace, without a blank line. Preserve complete groups with copyright, redistribution, permission, license/licence, warranty, public-domain or all-rights-reserved wording. Groups can include preceding inline technical comment context.
